_doc: SPEC_PET_ATHLETICS §3.2 — design-axis picks to attribute deltas. {axis: {option: {attribute: delta}}}. This is what the kids actually asked for: the design MEANS something — a chubby corgi is slower and stronger than a lean one. An axis or option with no entry contributes nothing, so adding a design axis never breaks athletics; every {axis, option} named here must resolve against design_axes (guard test). Deltas apply to speed/power/endurance only, never to a medium affinity — the body you drew changes how hard you go, not which element you belong to.
